## Photo Organizer (Cb)

The edit-side companion to Property Gallery: reorder photos (HTML5 drag-and-drop plus Move left/right buttons as the keyboard path), choose the hero (badge follows its photo through reorders), and write per-photo captions.

### Contract (mutates the passed model)

- `@model` — structurally typed `{ photos?: { images?, resolvedUrls? }; photoCaptions?: string[]; heroIndex?: number | null }`, so it never imports the card and cannot create a module cycle.
- All three arrays move together: reordering `photos.images` reorders `photoCaptions` and remaps `heroIndex` in the same write. `containsMany` arrays are replaced wholesale (the MultiImageSourceField editor idiom), never index-assigned.

### Why captions live on the card

MultiImageSourceField is a shared catalog field with no caption slot; extending it is a boxel-catalog change. The parallel `photoCaptions` array is the additive alternative, and this organizer is the ONLY writer that keeps the arrays coupled.

### Non-goals

No uploads (the field's own editor owns add/remove), no display (Property Gallery owns that).
